name: Quintana Redonda (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over green, charged at the centre with the round emblem of Quintana Redonda (a black jug and a tree on white within a red ring).
history: Municipal flag of Quintana Redonda; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Quintana Redonda emblem — black jug and tree on white within a red ring
